items.t: Lemonade Announces Online Viewing Details for 2026 Investor Day
items.sum: Lemonade, Inc. (NYSE: LMND) will hold its third Investor Day on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in New York City. The program begins at 9:00 a.m. ET.
